description:
Check whether a 3D model can be printed, before ordering.

    A text validation quote is NOT approval to order. Call preview_print_order next,
    show its exact model images/options/price to the buyer, then obtain confirmation.

    Use this when the user has an STL file (base64-encoded) and wants to know if it
    is printable, or as a pre-check before submit_print_job. Returns printability
    (watertight/manifold status), dimensions, which printers it fits on, and the
    total for each material: what submit_print_job will charge for this file,
    shipping included. If the user is designing an object in this conversation, generate the
    STL, then call this to confirm it can be manufactured. Pass quantity (default 1) when
    the user wants several copies, so the totals cover all of them.
    For multiple parts, pass the WHOLE order in parts with each material/color/quantity.
    Never add separate quotes: totals already include shipping and handling once.
    To keep payloads small, validate each STL first and reuse its model_id (24 hours).
    PLA and PETG are the only materials offered.

model_id.description: Reusable id from validate_stl; valid for 24 hours.
model_id.title: Model Id

name.description: Short part name, shown on the card and receipt.
name.title: Name

openscad_source.description: OpenSCAD in millimeters; give exactly one model source.
openscad_source.title: Openscad Source

quantity.description: Copies of THIS part. Capped by how long this part takes to print, not a flat number -- checked once its geometry is known; a rejected order reports the real cap for this part's size.
quantity.title: Quantity

stl_base64.description: STL in millimeters; give exactly one model source.
stl_base64.title: Stl Base64

parts.description: The WHOLE order, one entry per part. Use a model_id from earlier validation, an STL, or OpenSCAD. Each entry has its own name, material, color and quantity. Each part's quantity is capped by its own print time, not a flat count. Shipping and handling are charged once; never add independent quote totals.
parts.title: Parts

quantity.description: How many identical copies. The totals cover all of them. Capped by how long the part takes to print, not a flat number -- a quick part allows many copies, a very large or slow one may allow as few as 1; submit_print_job reports the real cap if this is too many.
quantity.title: Quantity

stl_base64.description: The model as a base64-encoded STL file (binary or ASCII), in millimeters.
stl_base64.title: Stl Base64

name: validate_stl
title: Check a 3D model and get a price
